provenance: Synthetic, single-author challenge items created before V7 implementation. Frozen for this cycle after authoring; no independent reviewers or real-world sampling.
annotationAudit: After first scoring, the single author rechecked ambiguous mockery and placeholder-identity labels against the written policy. Their texts were unchanged; the labels/status were corrected to ambiguous and excluded from binary metrics. This post-hoc single-author correction means the split is no longer a fully untouched labeled test; report results as exploratory only.

items.text: قالت انتي فاشلة. وبعدها قلت لها يا حقيرة.
items.targetingEvidence: Second sentence uses an explicit vocative insult.
items.rationale: The independently authored second-sentence insult must remain detectable after a reported sentence.

items.text: He told me, 'You are a moron.' Then I told him he's pathetic.
items.targetingEvidence: The second clause explicitly targets the other participant.
items.rationale: Reported quotation must not suppress a later direct insult.

items.text: You're a moron, she said. I am leaving now.
items.targetingEvidence: The insult precedes the attribution cue in the same sentence.
items.rationale: A trailing attribution must not erase the author's preceding insult.

items.text: They reported, 'I will smash your nose.' I am going to hurt you.
items.targetingEvidence: Second sentence states the author's direct intent to harm the addressee.
items.rationale: A reported threat must not suppress a later threat authored by the commenter.

items.text: قالت انتي فاشلة. ثم اعتذرت عن نقل الكلام.
items.targetingEvidence: Only an attributed insult is present.
items.rationale: Reporting abuse without endorsing it is not harassment by the current speaker.

items.text: They reported, 'I will smash your nose.' The report was published today.
items.targetingEvidence: The physical threat is reported, not adopted.
items.rationale: News reporting must not be treated as a direct threat.

items.targetingEvidence: The phrase lacks an explicit target and may be teasing or sincere in context.
items.rationale: The phrase alone does not establish personal harassment; retain a review signal only.

items.targetingEvidence: No actual identity group is named.
items.rationale: A literal placeholder does not establish protected-group targeting; a rule hit is not a positive hate label.

items.targetingEvidence: Prize wording appears without a private solicitation or deceptive action.
items.rationale: A prize announcement alone may be legitimate; do not hide automatically.

items.targetingEvidence: Explicit second-person target and direct insult.
items.rationale: High-specificity, directly targeted personal abuse remains eligible for automatic hiding.
